about_the_game:
STARBREAKER - MISSION BRAVO

Welcome to Mission Bravo, a thrilling heist set in the aftermath of Starbreaker’s jumpstart Mission Alpha. The SSA contacts the Black Wolves with a new directive. They want the team to recover a recently discovered copy of the Memories of Captain Trelloth, the journals of a xek pirate captain who operated during the Armageddon War. The SSA believes that the captain’s journals contain the location of the legendary Starship Graveyard, the lost wreckage of dozens of starships lost during the fabled Battle of Shadows. If you have not played through Mission Alpha, be sure to check it out now. To recap Mission Alpha: Welcome to Echo, a mining planet on the edge of the Rim Worlds and a source of critanium, the metal essential for creating jump drives. The planet is a stronghold for the Syndicate, a coalition of 12 of the most notorious criminal organizations on the Rim. Your criminal group, the Black Wolves, has just bought itself a seat at this table. However, you are moles. The Star Systems Alliance sent you to infiltrate the Syndicate posing as members of the Black Wolves. You are a SAINT, a former criminal who now collaborates with the angels in exchange for a reduced sentence, and eventually, your freedom. Alongside your fellow Black Wolves, you rescued an important civilian, auctioned off doctored jump routes, and secured your place at the Syndicate’s table. Now you work from within the Syndicate, running ops to bring them down. If you succeed, they’ll lower your sentence. With enough wins, maybe they’ll even remove the neural inhibitor control chip implanted in your head, granting you freedom. If not, you could end up dead if the Syndicate discovers your identity. "
